about:
Apparel Empire Sourcing & Textiles operates from Edmond, Oklahoma, as a supply chain management firm specializing in textile products. The company serves both international and domestic clients, focusing on understanding diverse market needs.

The company provides sourcing services across a range of textile categories including apparel, home textiles, hosiery, leather goods, sports equipment, fabrics, yarn, accessories, and knits. It emphasizes the ability to process high-volume orders on rigid schedules, supported by a team of skilled employees who manage supply chain logistics and quality assurance.

Its customer base spans international and domestic buyers seeking textile products, with the company positioning itself as a flexible partner capable of adapting quickly to specific client requirements. The firm highlights its placement in a leading textile-producing region to offer competitive quality, pricing, and timely delivery.

Apparel Empire differentiates itself through a flexible structure and strong customer focus, offering specialized individual support to build long-term relationships. The company states its key advantage is the ability to adapt to customer desires in the shortest possible time while maintaining consistent quality.
